containerDefinitions.name: admin-query
command:
import asyncio; from sqlalchemy import text; from src.database import async_session
async def m():
  async with async_session() as s:
    cols = (await s.execute(text("SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' ORDER BY ordinal_position"))).all()
    print('=== users columns ===')
    for c in cols:
      print(f'  {c[0]}: {c[1]}')
    rows = (await s.execute(text('SELECT * FROM users'))).mappings().all()
    print(f'=== {len(rows)} user(s) ===')
    for r in rows:
      print(dict(r))
asyncio.run(m())
